title: Videns Dominus (La Fage)
desc: Jean de la Fage, Videns Dominus. 4 voices (Superius, Altus, Tenor, Bassus), each on its own staff. No text in this edition. Note values as in the edition (whole note = semibreve), at the original pitch; coloured notes stand for the triplet groups; editorial accidentals small above the staff.
cr: From The 1520s Project (1520s-project.org, Lfg2001); encoded by Benjamin Ory. Licence: CC BY-NC 4.0.
